notes.title: GRAND MOUNTAIN ADVENTURE: WONDERLANDS SHOWS OFF ITS GAMEPLAY IN A NEW TRAILER
notes.content:
Microids Indie is pleased to introduce you the brand new gameplay trailer of the game Grand Mountain Adventure: Wonderlands. 

Developed by Swedish studio Toppluva, Grand Mountain Adventure: Wonderlands is a refreshing open-world ski and snowboard game in which players freely explore snowy slopes filled with hundreds of challenges to discover. 


Discover the specifics of the game in a brand new video: exploration, vast environments, challenges and tricks, local multiplayer or peace and quiet with the Zen Mode, all powder lovers will be happy! 

[previewyoutube=k8y96w2DD0E;full][/previewyoutube]

Game features :

- An ode to exploration: Put on your skis or snowboard and explore 12 open-world winter sports resorts. Discover places you've never visited before in off-piste mode, from vast wild forests to the highest rocky peaks, from dizzying descents to isolated villages. 

- Many challenges await you in the mountains: Take on Super G, Slopestyle, Big Air slaloms, find numerous collectibles, and much more! Hidden challenges and secret trails also await the most adventurous. 

- Slide alone or with friends: Play local multiplayer with up to 4 players. Reach the finish line, knock your friends off their feet by hitting them or throwing snowballs at them. Explore the mountains on your own or with others!

- Relax with Zen Mode: Zen Mode allows you to take a break and spend some quiet, relaxing time. All challenges, collectables and even NPCs are removed so you can enjoy the peace and quiet of the mountains with a glass of hot chocolate at hand!

CONNECT WITH US!

For the latest news and announcements, don't forget to visit our social channels. 
Twitter   Facebook   Instagram  Discord

Microids Team
